text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The distinguished autumn Tenno Sho<n>has arrived,
and Biwa Hayahide<n>examines my face closely
while<n>we're in the prep room.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Since she's a worrier at heart, she<n>can't help but
check to see if I've<n>been keeping my promise to
get more<n>sleep.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Satisfied that I am, she heads to the<n>race, ready to
prove the effectiveness<n>of the winning equation
we've built<n>together.
